card.name: The word early in risk-timing warnings
card.fires_on: The word "early" in the NSAID cardiovascular warning sentence "This risk may occur early in treatment". It follows "may occur" and comes just before "in treatment".

modes.label: Early onset of risk
modes.description: "early" after "This risk may occur" in the boxed cardiovascular thrombotic events warning.
